title: Reed Bank
shortDescription: A west bank of reed and slow brown water.
longDescription:
Reed grows thicker on this bank. The river is slow and brown and smells of wet leaves. No pirates standing here. The rope-island is south, and it is less polite.
East is the landing.

fixtures.name: Reed Bundles
fixtures.lookDescription: Reed cut and stacked. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: Someone cut reed and did not take it to Sile's mere. These bundles are for the landing's leaky skiff. A few stalks are mashed where a boot stood too long.
